About
Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Process

How Milestone Works

1
Step 1

Proof of Value

We define success criteria, align stakeholders, and run a time-boxed proof of value with your onboarding team to demonstrate relevance, accuracy, and impact in your environment.

2
Step 2

Integration & Data Activation

We integrate with your development and delivery tools, establish secure data pipelines, and activate the datasets required to support reliable, ongoing analysis.

3
Step 3

Enablement & Adoption

We provide training, education, and hands-on enablement to ensure your teams understand the platform, trust the metrics, and can confidently apply insights in day-to-day decision-making.

4
Step 4

Customisation & Advanced Use

For organisations with advanced requirements, we support custom analyses, tailored metrics, and deeper integrations aligned to your operating model and strategic goals.
